Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely declared the task complete and provided the incorrect project ("Tube Alloys") instead of the correct answer ("Manhattan Project"). While James Chadwick did lead the British Tube Alloys program, the question asks which project the discoverer of the neutron participated in—Chadwick was a key participant in the Manhattan Project as head of the British Mission. The misselection stems from misinterpreting the task focus and not validating against the more widely recognized association.
